headline: OpenAI's Luna keeps climbing; DeepSeek holds firm at #2
summary: OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 hit an all-time token-share record of 23.5% (day 2 of the streak), while DeepSeek and Zhipu AI swapped positions overnight. Three models entered the top 50, and three dropped out. The top two providers now command 47.1% of traffic between them.

deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 climbs 2 ranks to #2 (8.6%); z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-20260826 rises to #3 (8.4%)
